summary.note_dlam: deltaLambda sorts the EIGENVALUES e_j of diag(dOff)+A and returns dlam_j = e_j - dOff_j; with dOff(2) = 7428.6 the increments are measured from different baselines and need not be ordered. The constraint-relevant ordering is lam_j + dlam_j = lam_1 + e_j, which IS ordered (all_row1_le_row2).
